notes: N-426 cross-SDK vector: the stateful change-address guard. A stateful covenant that takes _changePKH rebuilds its change output from hash160(changePubKey ?? signer pubkey), so a call whose changeAddress names a different key builds a spend the network rejects. Every SDK refuses that call BEFORE signing or broadcast with the shared message. Replay with the contract, UTXOs and signer key of stateful-merge-prepared.json (single contract input, no additionalContractInputs), method `increment`, null Sig. Cases: (1) changeAddress=otherAddress, no changePubKey -> refused with message (message template with {changeAddress} replaced by otherAddress), nothing broadcast; (2) changeAddress=otherAddress + changePubKey=otherPubKeyHex -> accepted and broadcast; (3) changeAddress=the signer's own address, no changePubKey -> accepted and broadcast. Stateless calls are unaffected. Validated against @bsv/sdk Spend by conformance/sdk-call/n426-change-address-guard.test.ts.
message: changeAddress {changeAddress} does not match the change key the covenant enforces (hash160 of changePubKey, or of the signer's key when changePubKey is unset); pass changePubKey for that address
